skill.summary: Tired of spending hours storyboarding, filming, and editing just to bring a simple idea to life? Text-to-video-ai-2026 lets you skip the production pipeline...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Text-to-Video AI 2026 — instant video creation from text prompts.

- Instantly generate rendered MP4 videos from written prompts, using 2026 AI video models.
- Supports various workflows: marketing, education, content creation, social media.
- Automatic connection setup with 100 free credits for new users (via quick anonymous token).
- Flexible prompt routing: generate, edit, upload, export, check credits or status.
- Handles narration, captions, animation styles, aspect ratios, and editing iterations.
- Error handling for session, token, credit, and export issues; guides users as needed.
